question.text:
Let D equal 1 at rational points of [0, 1] and 0 at irrational points. On equal partitions, all-
rational tags give Riemann sums 1, while all-irrational tags give sums 0. Which conclusion
follows?
(A) The integral is 1/2.
(B) The integral is 0.
(C) The integral is 1.
(D) D is not Riemann integrable.
(E) Only the rational-tag sums are permitted.

solution.text:
Both choices of tags are valid and both partition meshes tend to zero. Riemann integra-
bility requires a common limit for every such choice. The two distinct limits disprove
integrability; boundedness alone is insufficient.
